4.
(1)  The  Corporation  shall  have  the  power  to  do,
perform  and  execute  all  such  acts,  matters  and  things
whatsoever as are necessary or desirable for the promotion
or furtherance of the objects of the Corporation or any one
of them including the power to open, operate or close non-
interest  bearing  bank  accounts,  to  borrow  or  raise  money
free of interest with or without security, to receive, collect,
disburse grants and donations, to invest its funds to construct
any buildings on any land vested in, or acquired or held by
the Corporation, to acquire, purchase, lease or rent land, to
invest  in  movable  property  and  chooses  in  action,  and  to
engage,  employ  and  dismiss  personnel  for  the  purpose  of
carrying out all or any of the objects of the Corporation:
Provided, however, the powers of the Corporation shall
at all times be exercised in compliance with the principles
of sunnath wal jamaath.
(2) The Corporation shall also have the power to institute
legal proceedings in respect of any property claimed to be
owned,  possessed,  belonging  to  ,  dedicated  or  associated
with or managed for and on behalf of the Founding Spiritual
Head, Association or Corporation as the case may be.
